title: Fool Night Manga Gets TV Anime From Sunrise, Shaft on Netflix Worldwide This Year
content: Netflix announced during its Anime Studio Focus panel at this year's Annecy International Festival event on Wednesday that Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga is getting a television anime. The anime will debut worldwide on Netflix in 2026. The new anime is the first ever collaboration between Sunrise and SHAFT .
author: ANN

title: 'The Ribbon Hero' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Song, Second Trailer
content: The official website of the The Ribbon Hero original anime movie revealed additional cast and a second trailer on Tuesday. The anime movie based on Osamu Tezuka 's Ribbon no Kishi ( Princess Knight ) manga will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on August 8.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Fool Night Anime by SHAFT and SUNRISE Announced With Trailer, Visual, 2026 Netflix Release
content: FOOL NIGHT anime adaptation by studios SHAFT and SUNRISE was officially announced, revealing a teaser trailer, visual, cast, and 2026 Netflix release. This is the first-ever joint project between the two studios. Atsuyuki Yukawa will direct, with the anime being his directorial debut.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Game's Trailer Previews Story, New Characters, West City
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming on Tuesday a new trailer for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 , the third game in the Dragon Ball Xenoverse series. The video, titled "Welcome to West City Trailer," introduces original characters Brett, Lilica, ROM, and Tap.
author: ANN

title: The Ribbon Hero Anime Film's 2nd Trailer Unveils More Cast, Theme Song
content: Anime studio Twin Engine posted the second trailer for The Ribbon Hero , its new anime film based on Osamu Tezuka 's Princess Knight ( Ribbon no Kishi ) manga, on Tuesday. The trailer announces more cast members, and it also announces and previews the theme song "Reborn" by the Japanese/Korean group Girls Archives.
author: ANN

title: THE RIBBON HERO Reveals New Trailer, Theme Song by Girls Archives, Additional Voice Cast
content: THE RIBBON HERO , the new film based on Osamu Tezuka’s Ribbon no Kishi ( Princess Knight ) has revealed a new trailer, theme song and additional voice cast. This is the franchise’s first anime project in 27 years , and it will premiere globally exclusively on Netflix on August 8, 2026.
